# Package-owned Home fixture snapshot

`wrn-g3-016-public` preserves the eight JSON documents previously imported
directly from Mobile by the G3-016 Home fixture test, unchanged at `8ee6fb5`.
The fixture generator comparison remains intact. Workspace-level
`tools/check-public-fixture-parity.mjs` separately binds these snapshots to
the real Mobile artifacts and rejects drift or missing files.

These are neutral, self-authored local test articles, not admitted live news.
No fixture or public content is regenerated automatically by a check.
